verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents its own REST API v3 for automating workspace workflows without the UI, and an MCP server that headless agent CLIs such as Codex CLI can connect to. That gives a first-party, non-UI path to automation, but nothing shows a dedicated CLI, CI integration, or service-token guidance for pipelines. missing for 10: official CLI or CI/GitHub Action for headless runs, documented non-interactive auth for CI, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use this API to build custom integrations or automate even more of your workspace’s workflow.
We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
Setup guide for connecting Codex CLI to Shortcut through the Shortcut MCP server.
